name: Ambrose
source:
[i]"Beauty has become a blade, light has been swallowed by darkness, and art has been reduced to being a witch's den."[/i]

[i]Dream-Inhabiting Creator[/i]

A peerless artist. Though he was famous long ago as the "Millennium Artist," his soul now resides within a mascot costume. But that comical appearance clashes with his stern tone.

The artworks he created boast more than just beauty; within them lies a strange and otherworldly power.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=ambrose]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
